gaps.text: None of the srn_weapon resources, srn_2da/baseitems.2da or the publication manifest exist at the SR_NWN-pinned commit; SR_NWN must advance its SRN_HAKS submodule to consume this slice.
srn_2da/baseitems.2da changes Sling row 61 ModelType 0->2 and MaxRange 50->52 for the whole Sling family. Ordinary/stock simple-model slings are not client-qualified under this table.
srn_2da ships a complete baseitems.2da. Any SR_NWN or other HAK baseitems change requires an intentional row-level merge; load order is not a substitute.

Colt L36 retains Sling gameplay (damage, range, feats, ammunition). No firearm rules, ammunition items, projectile models or ammunition tables are published; sling projectiles fall back to the installed game.
No sling bullet blueprint, ammunition model/icon, projectile model or ammunitiontypes.2da override exists in any SRN_HAKS pack. The bullets row is carried unchanged.
All five blueprints have Cost 0 and no item properties; they are builder templates without balance data. Combat stats come only from the base item row.

No combat.* TLK allocations exist (SR_NWN-owned keys: 8, all phenomorpher race strings). The weapon blueprints need no TLK entries; any combat UI/feedback strings SR_NWN needs must be allocated with tools/Allocate-StrRef.ps1.
PROVENANCE.md records operator-supplied references and Pixal3D generation but not the origin/license of the reference images or the generator terms for redistributed outputs.
The Colt L36 and Cougar names/branding are third-party marks; PROVENANCE.md explicitly does not assert ownership. GOVERNANCE.md requires trademark review per batch; no recorded clearance.
User acceptance covers the shipped Human fixture only; individual animation, armor, glove and off-hand cases and other bodies (c7 lock) were not separately client-tested.
Weapon resrefs were not compared against an installed NWN:EE key/bif set in this run.
16 srn_weapon resrefs also exist with different bytes in the staged (quarantined) MDRNEE item HAK; a future MDRNEE promotion must renumber or drop them.
10 staged MDRNEE blueprints use legacy BaseItem 61 as a dual-wield handgun; in the EE baseline row 61 is the Sling hosting the Colt L36.

sr_cfs uses model parts [101] outside baseitems row 1 MinRange/MaxRange 10-100. The toolset part picker cannot select it; the shipped blueprint was client-reviewed as-is. SR_NWN-authored variants must copy the blueprint rather than re-pick parts, or a reviewed MaxRange merge is needed.
